{{Quote|Heh, heh. You were lucky to get through those cultists.|[[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bone Gnasher|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Cult of the Krayt''', best known simply as the '''Krayt Cult''', was a cult on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that worshiped [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]].

==History==
{{Quote|Oldksam can help you. He is hiding out in the Krayt Cult cave.|[[Taibela]], to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]|<ref name="SWG:FJ" />}}
[[File:Krayt_cultists.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Krayt cultists in their cave.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the cultists lived in a [[Krayt Cult Cave|cave]] in the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. They worshiped a large krayt dragon skull in the depth of the cave.<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> Titles or ranks in this cult included novices, acolytes, ministrants, monks and zealots.<ref name="SWGTCGPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Tori Radeen]] asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to go into the cave and bring her the poison glands of [[bone gnasher]]s that lived in the cave in order to create a new poison.<ref name="JDW" /> Around the same time, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Oldksam]] was hiding inside the cave because he thought the crime boss [[Faeto]] wanted to have him assassinated.<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> In the meantime, [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Ellis Arrison]] ordered a young [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] to attack Krayt Cultists in their cave as part of his officer combat training.<ref name="SWG:OM1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Officer Mission 1|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Krayt Cult appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Krayt Cult was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

In the cut quest "Cult of the Krayt," [[Brannix Tzg'ada]] would have tasked a spacer with eliminating Krayt cultists in the
Krayt Cult Cave. This quest would have extended the background story of the Krayt Cult, revealing for example that Krayt cultists might feed their children to Krayt Dragons.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}} &dmdash; tatooine_eisley_brannix.st, tatooine_eisley_krayt_cult.stf</ref>
